scripts.bench:baseline: pnpm run build:release && node scripts/benchmark-baseline.mjs --output benchmarks/baseline.json --profile release --trials 3
scripts.bench:report: pnpm run build:release && node scripts/benchmark-baseline.mjs --output benchmarks/current.json --profile release --trials 3
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run fixtures:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run docs:check
scripts.docs:check: pnpm run docs:test && pnpm run docs:build
scripts.format: cargo fmt --all && cargo fmt --manifest-path fuzz/Cargo.toml && cargo fmt --manifest-path vendor/allsorts/Cargo.toml && cargo fmt --manifest-path vendor/safer-bytes/Cargo.toml && oxfmt
scripts.format:check: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path fuzz/Cargo.toml --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path vendor/allsorts/Cargo.toml --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path vendor/safer-bytes/Cargo.toml --check && oxfmt --check .
scripts.fuzz:smoke: pnpm run fuzz:corpus && RUSTC="$(rustup which --toolchain nightly rustc)" cargo fuzz run public_api --sanitizer address -- -runs=256 -max_len=1048576 -timeout=10
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path vendor/safer-bytes/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && oxlint --deny-warnings
scripts.package:smoke: pnpm run build:debug && pnpm --filter @fontmin-rs/binding artifacts && pnpm --filter fontmin-rs build && node scripts/ensure-wasm.mjs && node scripts/package-smoke.mjs
scripts.release:check: pnpm run release:metadata && pnpm run check && pnpm run security:check && pnpm run coverage:check && pnpm run package:smoke && pnpm run release:pack
scripts.security:check: cargo deny check advisories sources && pnpm audit --audit-level high
scripts.test: pnpm run build:debug && pnpm run build && pnpm -C wasm/fontmin test && pnpm --workspace-concurrency=1 --filter fontmin-rs test && cargo test --locked --workspace && cargo test --locked --manifest-path vendor/allsorts/Cargo.toml --test cff_index && pnpm run test:tools
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter fontmin-rs typecheck && pnpm -C wasm/fontmin typecheck
